name: asistente-docente
description: Asistente docente / Teaching Assistant — Materiales y evaluación docente. Course materials, assignments, quizzes and Moodle feedback in English or Spanish.

interface.longDescription: Organiza tu curso, crea materiales y prepara cuestionarios y comentarios para Moodle. Set up your course, explore your course map, design assignments, grade submissions and prepare printable quizzes with Moodle feedback. Work in English or Spanish and choose a different language for your handouts.
